headline: MBBS-Trained Physician | Clinical Evidence, Scientific Exchange and Medical Education
summary: MBBS-trained physician with emergency, ICU and occupational health experience and four years in health technology. I reviewed clinical literature for evidence-based EHR content, presented to clinicians at Greenway's provider conference and to client leadership, and trained 200+ providers and nurses. I have not held an MSL or medical affairs title and have no oncology-specific practice; I am looking to move my clinical and scientific communication skills into medical affairs.
greenway_bullets: Reviewed clinical literature on the Clinical Content Team to keep EHR clinical content evidence-based and aligned with guidelines.
Presented clinical and product concepts to provider audiences at the Greenway Engage conference and directly to client clinical leadership.
Designed and delivered training for 200+ clinicians and staff, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants.
Patient Safety Committee member: triaged patient safety issues and defects from detection through stage-gate release.
Main clinical contact for close to 200 client practices, translating clinician needs into product decisions.
skills: literature review, evidence synthesis, presentations to clinicians, clinician education
emergency medicine, critical care, occupational health, clinical AI evaluation
relationships with clinicians and leadership, patient safety review
thesis_html: Turning clinical evidence into something clinicians can use.
why_fit: Evidence-based clinical content for an EHR.
Providers, NPs, nurses and medical assistants.
